channel.title: Lake Havasu City, AZ - News Flash
channel.description: Lake Havasu City, AZ - Get the latest news

item.title: Lake Havasu City to Begin Street and Parking Lot Sealing Operations October 18
item.description: Lake Havasu City is scheduled to begin street and parking lot sealing operations on Sunday, October 18, 2026

item.title: LHCPD Awarded Governor’s Office of Highway Safety Grant
item.description: The Lake Havasu City Police Department was awarded a grant in the amount of $41,024.00 from the Governor’s Office of Highway Safety

item.title: London Bridge Days Parade, Changes to Route and Road Closure
item.description: Lake Havasu City is preparing to celebrate the 55th anniversary of the London Bridge Days Parade on Saturday, October 24.

item.title: Road Rage Incident Leads to Shooting Arrest
item.description: On September 26, 2026, at approximately 10:17 p.m., officers with the LHCPD was dispatched to the area of Acoma Boulevard North and McCulloch Boulevard North in reference to a reported road-rage incident and possible shooting.

item.title: Narcotics Investigation Leads to Arrests
item.description: Two Lake Havasu City residents were arrested following a drug investigation that included a search warrant served at a Richey Circle residence.

item.title: Mayor Cal Sheehy Reelected as Chair of Clean Colorado River Sustainability Coalition
item.description: Lake Havasu City Mayor Cal Sheehy was reelected Chair of the Clean Colorado River Sustainability Coalition (CCRSCo)

item.title: Lake Havasu City General Election – November 3, 2026
item.description: A reminder: Lake Havasu City is holding a General Election on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, to elect one Councilmember and to propose to the voters ratification of the 2026 Lake Havasu City General Plan: Shaping Our Future.

item.title: Residential Fire
item.description: At approximately 4:38 pm on Thursday, September 17, 2026, a fire was reported by the homeowner in the 3800 block of Deerpath Drive.
